fullText.simplified:
我每天都在想她

    我拿着一雪的手表，回家了。
    我看着手表，不想吃饭，不想睡觉，不想说话，觉得做什么事都没意思。我真想回到大学的时候，真想告诉一雪，我也喜欢她。这样，她可能就不会生病了，我们现在就在一起了。
    我每天都不高兴，小月看到了，问：“你怎么了？为什么不去公园了？”
    我不想和小月说话，也不想看她。我觉得一雪生病是因为我，她的病不能好也是因为我。我对不起一雪，所以我不能和小月好好说话了。
    小月说：“你去外面走走吧，对身体好。”
    我不想和小月说话，所以我去了公园。下雪了，很冷。
    我坐在椅子上，还是想着一雪。我每天都在想她，吃饭的时候想，看书的时候想，睡觉的时候也想。我正在想我是不是病了，这时候，小月打电话来了。
    小月在电话里问：“我看到一块红色的手表，这是我大学时候的手表，你在哪儿找到的？”
fullText.traditional:
我每天都在想她

    我拿著一雪的手錶，回家了。
    我看著手錶，不想吃飯，不想睡覺，不想說話，覺得做什麼事都沒意思。我真想回到大學的時候，真想告訴一雪，我也喜歡她。這樣，她可能就不會生病了，我們現在就在一起了。
    我每天都不高興，小月看到了，問：“你怎麼了？為什麼不去公園了？”
    我不想和小月說話，也不想看她。我覺得一雪生病是因為我，她的病不能好也是因為我。我對不起一雪，所以我不能和小月好好說話了。
    小月說：“你去外面走走吧，對身體好。”
    我不想和小月說話，所以我去了公園。下雪了，很冷。
    我坐在椅子上，還是想著一雪。我每天都在想她，吃飯的時候想，看書的時候想，睡覺的時候也想。我正在想我是不是病了，這時候，小月打電話來了。
    小月在電話裡問：“我看到一塊紅色的手錶，這是我大學時候的手錶，你在哪兒找到的？”

sentences.simplified: 我拿着一雪的手表，回家了。
sentences.traditional: 我拿著一雪的手錶，回家了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ ná zhe yī xuě de shǒu biǎo huí jiā le
sentences.english: I took Yixue’s watch and went home.

sentences.simplified: 我看着手表，不想吃饭，不想睡觉，不想说话，
sentences.traditional: 我看著手錶，不想吃飯，不想睡覺，不想說話，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kàn zhe shǒu biǎo bù xiǎng chī fàn bù xiǎng shuì jiào bù xiǎng shuō huà
sentences.english: I looked at the watch. I didn’t want to eat, I didn’t want to sleep, and I didn’t want to talk.

sentences.simplified: 觉得做什么事都没意思。
sentences.traditional: 覺得做什麼事都沒意思。
sentences.pinyin: jué de zuò shén me shì dōu méi yì si
sentences.english: I didn’t want to do anything.

sentences.simplified: 我真想回到大学的时候，真想告诉一雪，我也喜欢她。
sentences.traditional: 我真想回到大學的時候，真想告訴一雪，我也喜歡她。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhēn xiǎng huí dào dà xué de shí hou zhēn xiǎng gào su yī xuě wǒ yě xǐ huan tā
sentences.english: I really wanted to go back to when we were at college. I really wanted to tell Yixue that I liked her too.

sentences.simplified: 这样，她可能就不会生病了，我们现在就在一起了。
sentences.traditional: 這樣，她可能就不會生病了，我們現在就在一起了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng tā kě néng jiù bú huì shēng bìng le wǒ men xiàn zài jiù zài yì qǐ le
sentences.english: This way, she might not have gotten sick, and we would be together now.

sentences.simplified: 我每天都不高兴，小月看到了，问：“你怎么了？为什么不去公园了？”
sentences.traditional: 我每天都不高興，小月看到了，問：“你怎麼了？為什麼不去公園了？”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān dōu bù gāo xìng xiǎo yuè kàn dào le wèn nǐ zěn me le wèi shén me bú qù gōng yuán le
sentences.english: Little Yue noticed that I was unhappy every day and asked, “What’s wrong with you? Why didn’t you go to the park?”

sentences.simplified: 我不想和小月说话，也不想看她。
sentences.traditional: 我不想和小月說話，也不想看她。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng hé xiǎo yuè shuō huà yě bù xiǎng kàn tā
sentences.english: I didn’t want to talk to Little Yue, and I didn’t want to see her.

sentences.simplified: 我觉得一雪生病是因为我，她的病不能好也是因为我。
sentences.traditional: 我覺得一雪生病是因為我，她的病不能好也是因為我。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jué de yī xuě shēng bìng shì yīn wèi wǒ tā de bìng bù néng hǎo yě shì yīn wèi wǒ
sentences.english: I thought that Yixue fell sick because of me, and that she couldn’t recover from her illness because of me.

sentences.simplified: 我对不起一雪，所以我不能和小月好好说话了。
sentences.traditional: 我對不起一雪，所以我不能和小月好好說話了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ duì bu qǐ yī xuě suǒ yǐ wǒ bù néng hé xiǎo yuè hǎo hǎo shuō huà le
sentences.english: I let Yixue down, so I couldn’t talk to Little Yue properly.

sentences.simplified: 小月说：“你去外面走走吧，对身体好。”
sentences.traditional: 小月說：“你去外面走走吧，對身體好。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yuè shuō nǐ qù wài miàn zǒu zǒu ba duì shēn tǐ hǎo
sentences.english: Little Yue said, “Go outside for a walk. It’s good for your health.”

sentences.simplified: 我不想和小月说话，所以我去了公园。下雪了，很冷。
sentences.traditional: 我不想和小月說話，所以我去了公園。下雪了，很冷。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng hé xiǎo yuè shuō huà suǒ yǐ wǒ qù le gōng yuán xià xuě le hěn lěng
sentences.english: I didn’t want to talk to Little Yue, so I went to the park. It was snowing and it was cold.

sentences.simplified: 我坐在椅子上，还是想着一雪。
sentences.traditional: 我坐在椅子上，還是想著一雪。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zuò zài yǐ zi shang hái shi xiǎng zhe yī xuě
sentences.english: I was sitting in a chair, still thinking of Yixue.

sentences.simplified: 我每天都在想她，吃饭的时候想，看书的时候想，睡觉的时候也想。
sentences.traditional: 我每天都在想她，吃飯的時候想，看書的時候想，睡覺的時候也想。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān dōu zài xiǎng tā chī fàn de shí hou xiǎng kàn shū de shí hou xiǎng shuì jiào de shí hou yě xiǎng
sentences.english: I missed her every day. When I ate I missed her, when I read I missed her, and when I slept I missed her.

sentences.simplified: 我正在想我是不是病了，这时候，小月打电话来了。
sentences.traditional: 我正在想我是不是病了，這時候，小月打電話來了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhèng zài xiǎng wǒ shì bú shì bìng le zhè shí hou xiǎo yuè dǎ diàn huà lái le
sentences.english: I was wondering if I was sick. At this time, Little Yue called.

sentences.simplified: 小月在电话里问：“我看到一块红色的手表，这是我大学时候的手表，你在哪儿找到的？”
sentences.traditional: 小月在電話裡問：“我看到一塊紅色的手錶，這是我大學時候的手錶，你在哪兒找到的？”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yuè zài diàn huà lǐ wèn wǒ kàn dào yí kuài hóng sè de shǒu biǎo zhè shì wǒ dà xué shí hou de shǒu biǎo nǐ zài nǎ'r zhǎo dào de
sentences.english: Little Yue asked on the phone, “I noticed a red watch. This was my watch when I was at college. Where did you find it?”

sentence_translations: I took Yixue’s watch and went home.
I looked at the watch. I didn’t want to eat, I didn’t want to sleep, and I didn’t want to talk.
I didn’t want to do anything.
I really wanted to go back to when we were at college. I really wanted to tell Yixue that I liked her too.
This way, she might not have gotten sick, and we would be together now.
Little Yue noticed that I was unhappy every day and asked, “What’s wrong with you? Why didn’t you go to the park?”
I didn’t want to talk to Little Yue, and I didn’t want to see her.
I thought that Yixue fell sick because of me, and that she couldn’t recover from her illness because of me.
I let Yixue down, so I couldn’t talk to Little Yue properly.
Little Yue said, “Go outside for a walk. It’s good for your health.”
I didn’t want to talk to Little Yue, so I went to the park. It was snowing and it was cold.
I was sitting in a chair, still thinking of Yixue.
I missed her every day. When I ate I missed her, when I read I missed her, and when I slept I missed her.
I was wondering if I was sick. At this time, Little Yue called.
Little Yue asked on the phone, “I noticed a red watch. This was my watch when I was at college. Where did you find it?”
